title: Text models move onto a shared route
summary:
Text model routing got simpler, and `claude-hybridspace` became `claude`.

Scaleway-backed models and the former Cloudflare client now use the existing Portkey route. The migration retains model-specific prompts. The model list also renames `claude-hybridspace` to `claude` and describes it as Claude 3.5 Haiku; callers using the old name will need to update it.
